Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

Standardized Tool Used To Assign Runway Condition Codes Based On Surface Type And Contaminant Characteristics, Supporting Aircraft Performance Assessment.

Operational example

According To The Runway Condition‑Assessment Matrix, Code 2 Is Assigned When Wet Snow Covers More Than 25 Percent Of The Runway.
